results.name: Shipping containers
results.description:
A shipping container is a container with strength suitable to withstand shipment, storage, and handling. Shipping containers range from large reusable steel boxes used for intermodal shipments to the ubiquitous corrugated boxes. In the context of international shipping trade, "container" or "shipping container" is virtually synonymous with "intermodal freight container" (sometimes informally called a "sea can"), a container designed to be moved from one mode of transport to another without unloading and reloading.

Follow for more: </br>

results.name: Sea ​​container - Low Poly
results.description:
**Shipping container** is a **LowPoly** 3D model created specifically for import and use in a gaming context. The model of a sea container is worked out in detail, taking into account all the characteristics and features of real containers. The appearance of the model is original and authentic, thanks to the use of high-quality textures and realistic details.
The container has standard dimensions and complies with international standards. An important feature of the model is its adaptability for import into the game. Optimized file size and optimal coordinate system make it easy to integrate the model into the game engine.![](https://sun9-50.userapi.com/impg/Lslb7M0iWtKry_GsokWLpbtrb-OM0dGK-3oQqw/ClFDmQTjxl0.jpg?size=1920x1080&quality=96&sign=05e87b1ea7e16e5a243ae3c7bdb15d3c&type=album)![](https://sun9-9.userapi.com/impg/iQwABph1OBl39hUyfoLXHz8TeCPJGGfVM7wtcg/rGCBVEt1GEc.jpg?size=1920x1920&quality=96&sign=a78fc1633b6ff0d42bd265d13ab0815b&type=album)
